instruction: Export all Personal Address Book contacts from Thunderbird to contacts.csv on the Desktop, open it in LibreOffice Calc, and save as contacts.xlsx ensuring the file size is greater than 5KB.

metadata.explanation: Task requires XLSX file to be created with reasonable size (>5KB). Reference contacts_gold.xlsx is 9.6KB, so 5KB minimum is reasonable for 30 contacts with 37 columns.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Only checks file size, not data correctness or completeness
Cannot verify that contacts actually came from Thunderbird's Personal Address Book
Cannot verify that ALL contacts were exported (could pass with partial data)
File size threshold (5KB) is only 52% of reference size (9.6KB), allowing files with potentially incomplete data
No verification of data integrity - would pass with any XLSX file >5KB regardless of content
Missing verification of intermediate CSV creation step
Susceptible to false positives from pre-existing files or files with wrong/corrupted content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to parse XLSX and count rows/columns to verify expected data structure (30 contacts, 37 columns)
Add verification that specific contact fields exist (e.g., check for email addresses, names)
Increase minimum file size closer to reference (e.g., 8KB minimum for 30 contacts)
Consider adding checksum or content sampling to verify data authenticity
Add getter to verify CSV file was created as intermediate step
Add metric to check both file size AND row count to ensure completeness
